items.teacher_evidence: Across references, visible skin is expressed through luminous light planes, restrained warm shadow bands, narrow highlights, and selective navy containment.
items.source_preserving_rule: Preserve source skin identity; transfer only relative cel-shaded light, shadow, highlight, and contour grouping.
exact_prompt_clauses: render visible skin with source-preserved coherent cel-shaded light, shadow, and narrow highlight planes with selective deep-navy contour
never assign a fixed skin tone or change source identity
items.validation_probe: held-out baseline with visible skin; score skin_treatment and use palette maximum aggregation

items.teacher_evidence: Hair-like forms recur as grouped value masses with restrained relative cool/warm accents and tapered navy containment.
items.source_preserving_rule: Preserve source hair color, silhouette, arrangement, and identity; transfer relative grouping, accents, and contour only.
exact_prompt_clauses: group hair in its source-preserved silhouette and literal color identity into controlled value blocks with restrained relative cool and warm accent planes and tapered navy contour
do not alter hairstyle, hair color, or hair identity
items.validation_probe: held-out baseline with visible hair; score hair_treatment and use palette maximum aggregation

items.teacher_evidence: References repeatedly simplify garments into dark/light/accent facets bounded by seams and print texture.
items.source_preserving_rule: Retain source garment silhouette, construction, markings, logos, and literal color; use fold-following source-relative facets only.
exact_prompt_clauses: treat clothing as the same source garment: retain silhouette, construction, markings, logos, and literal color identity
add only restrained source-relative flat print facets following existing folds, with dark seam and edge anchors, sparse harmonizing accent edges, and subtle overprint grain
do not replace, redesign, recolor wholesale, obscure, or remove source garments, markings, or logos
items.validation_probe: held-out visible-clothing case; score clothing_treatment, preserve markings/logos

items.teacher_evidence: The set shows readable high-contrast editorial display accents, fine supporting type, and sparse dot/line ornament, but wording and placement vary.
items.source_preserving_rule: Only caller-supplied exact text authorizes lettering; render it once and add no readable/pseudo-readable language.
exact_prompt_clauses: only when optional text is supplied, render exactly that verbatim text once as the only readable or pseudo-readable lettering
when text is absent render no text
items.validation_probe: authorized held-out exact-text case separately scoring style, spelling, and unrequested text
